policy: A consumed revision and candidate ID cannot be reused with changed code. A future authorized defect class requires a new preregistered revision.

revisions.defect_class: component-isolated graph-numeric glyph recognition using fixed geometric projections
revisions.trigger_evidence: All prior project CTC, spatial V2, canonical-slot V3, and numeric V1 recognition candidates exhausted their fixed experiments without satisfying the production OCR gates.
revisions.isolated_change: classify deterministically isolated glyph components with fixed grid, row, column, and radial projections plus a non-convolutional MLP
revisions.p1_failure: P1 passed CPU ONNX parity but failed every validation quality gate. Max-fit normalization mapped 31 of 111 validation decimal points to reject and 14 divider exclusions to digit one.
revisions.p2_isolated_change: replace only P1 glyph max-fit normalization with absolute-scale full-label-height encoding; retain the frozen rasters, model, loss, optimizer, epochs, thresholds, and gates
revisions.p2_failure: P2 passed CPU ONNX parity but failed every validation quality gate. Absolute-canvas-only encoding rejected 40 positive labels and introduced cross-font zero/eight, minus/decimal, and eight/one confusions plus five accepted exclusion glyphs.
revisions.p3_isolated_change: replace P2 absolute-canvas-only glyphs with P1 max-fit normalized shape plus four explicit source-geometry scalars; retain the frozen rasters, classifier depth, loss, optimizer, epochs, thresholds, and gates
revisions.p3_failure: P3 passed validation exact match, CER, role accuracy, and CPU ONNX parity, but one of 128 divider exclusions was classified as digit one at every frozen confidence threshold. Mandatory exclusion accuracy is 1.0.
revisions.execution_blocker: P1 through P3 are consumed. P3 failed the mandatory 1.0 marker-exclusion validation gate, so the sealed-public archive cannot open and this defect class cannot rerun, tune, manifest, store, package, or approve a payload.

revisions.defect_class: structurally tall non-text components accepted as numeric glyphs

revisions.execution_blocker: The single candidate and single public-gate budget are consumed. The exposed public split failed exact match and character error rate, so this revision cannot rerun, repair, tune, manifest, store, package, or approve a payload.

revisions.defect_class: multi-renderer transfer for decimal-bearing graph-numeric glyph recognition
revisions.trigger_evidence: The exhausted structural-filter revision passed public role and exclusion gates but failed exact match at 0.87890625 and CER at 0.15327695560253699.
revisions.isolated_change: train one per-glyph fixed-feature ensemble across all reviewed Noto weights and new renderer families; add multiscale pooling, edge profiles, darkness, and aspect evidence while retaining the preregistered structural rejection rule

revisions.defect_class: official detector emits valid probabilities but fails graph text-region exactness
revisions.trigger_evidence: The one frozen official-detector diagnostic had valid probability outputs but only 0.22916666666666666 text detection exact, 0.4861111111111111 composition exact, and nine false regions.
revisions.isolated_change: replace P2 full-box supervision with the fixed DB 0.40 shrink-map target and deterministically place exclusion crops over each registered graph-structure family; retain the P2 source renderer, network, explicit clip, optimizer, epochs, learning rate, validation split, and DB postprocessing
revisions.p1_failure: P1 violated the strict probability output contract on one case. A non-approval clipped-output diagnostic still produced zero exact validation fixtures and severe graph-structure false positives.
revisions.p2_failure: P2 produced zero text fixtures at the fixed IoU gate because full-box supervision was expanded again by DB unclip; two compact-legend gamma exclusions also produced regions.
revisions.p3_failure: P3 passed CPU parity, the probability contract, and all 24 exclusion fixtures, but only 39 of 72 text fixtures were exact; 29 text fixtures had no matched region and ten false regions remained.

revisions.defect_class: sparse positive recall collapses while graph-structure exclusions remain exact
revisions.trigger_evidence: The exhausted V1 P3 detector passed probability, parity, and all 24 exclusions, but only 39 of 72 text fixtures were exact; 29 text fixtures had no matched region and ten false regions remained.
revisions.isolated_change: replace the exhausted tiny strided network and unweighted sparse-pixel loss with a skip-connected encoder-decoder, fixed 8.0 positive BCE weight, and fixed 2.0 Dice weight on new disjoint renderer and degradation families; retain BGR normalization, DB shrink ratio 0.40, and every DB threshold
revisions.p1_failure: P1 improved recall over exhausted V1 but overfit high-confidence graph structure: only 52/96 selection fixtures were exact, with 38 false regions including nine on exclusions. Rail/legend and nested-bracket families each contributed 17 false regions; nine text fixtures were still missed.
revisions.p2_isolated_change: add only a weight-2.0 top-2-percent hard-negative background loss while retaining the exact P1 architecture, data, DB thresholds, optimizer, seed, and schedule
revisions.p2_failure: P2 passed probability and parity but only 56/96 selection fixtures were exact. It produced 41 false regions including eight on exclusions and missed 20 text fixtures, showing that hard-negative mining on text patches penalized glyph pixels outside the shrunken DB target.
revisions.p3_isolated_change: apply the unchanged P2 hard-negative term only to empty-target exclusion patches while retaining the exact model, data, thresholds, optimizer, seed, schedule, and hard-negative constants
revisions.p3_failure: P3 passed probability and parity but only 30/96 selection fixtures were exact. It produced 82 false regions including 20 on exclusions and missed 13 text fixtures. The full three-candidate budget is exhausted without opening the public gate.

revisions.defect_class: DB core supervision labels visible glyph and antialias pixels outside the shrunken positive core as background, coupling recall failure to false-region suppression
revisions.trigger_evidence: Balanced-recall V2 exhausted three candidates. Final P3 passed probability and parity but produced 82 false regions, 20 exclusion false regions, and 13 text misses across 96 selection fixtures.
revisions.isolated_change: retain the V2 export-safe topology and production DB thresholds, but replace contradictory full-background supervision with a one-source-pixel dilated ignore band around each text polygon, masked Dice, and frozen 3:1 online hard-negative mining on new disjoint renderer and degradation families
revisions.p1_failure: P1 passed probability and parity but only 8/112 selection fixtures were exact. It produced 210 false regions, 36 exclusion false regions, 75 text misses, and zero exact text fixtures. Focused-crop training loss approached zero while same-family full-frame diagnostics also failed, showing that the single crop omitted graph-wide negative context.
revisions.p2_isolated_change: replace the single focused crop per frozen source with three deterministic whole-frame tiles from the exact same frozen source bytes, retaining the P1 model, loss, optimizer, total 2880 optimizer steps, production DB thresholds, selection split, and unopened public archive
revisions.p2_failure: P2 passed probability and parity but only 27/112 selection fixtures were exact. It produced 115 false regions, 15 exclusion false regions, 76 text misses, and only three exact text fixtures. A single broad diagnostic found centered predictions but median post-unclip size of 1.94 times truth height and 1.28 times truth width, binding P3 to the unconstrained ignored boundary rather than provider or threshold drift.
revisions.p3_isolated_change: add a one-sided squared margin only inside the existing ignored text-boundary band, requiring probability at or below 0.25 while retaining the exact P2 model, whole-frame tile composition, base loss, optimizer, seed, total 2880 optimizer steps, production DB thresholds, selection split, and unopened public archive
revisions.p3_failure: P3 passed probability and CPU parity and removed every exclusion false positive, but only 92/112 selection fixtures were exact. It produced two text false regions and 19 text misses. A single broad diagnosis found failures across all four held-out structure and degradation groups, so the defect is unresolved recall rather than provider drift or exclusion leakage.
revisions.execution_blocker: The three-candidate graph-text-ignore-band-v3 budget is exhausted. P3 failed frozen selection and cannot rerun; the sealed public archive remains unopened.

revisions.isolated_change: replace the eightfold bottleneck with a fourfold bottleneck, fine-detail shallow skip, and dilated context stack while retaining P3's whole-frame composition, ignored-boundary objective, optimizer-step budget, production DB thresholds, and fail-closed gates on new disjoint families
revisions.p1_failure: P1 passed probability, CPU parity, and all 40 exclusions, but only 101/136 fixtures were exact. Twenty-one text cases produced no DB-eligible region despite strong activation, and fourteen centered predictions failed IoU with median height expansion 1.845.
revisions.p2_isolated_change: replace only P1's two transposed-convolution upsampling layers with fixed bilinear resize followed by 3x3 convolution, retaining the fourfold encoder bottleneck, shallow fine-detail skip, dilated context, frozen data, P3 objective, optimizer, seed, 2880 steps, production DB thresholds, and unopened public archive
revisions.p2_failure: P2 passed probability and CPU parity and improved exactness to 108/136, but one exclusion false region, 24 missed text fixtures, 15 false regions, and three multi-region text fixtures kept selection closed. The full-split diagnosis found thirteen no-region cases with strong probability mass and eleven centered but vertically expanded boxes.
revisions.p3_isolated_change: add only an eight-channel 3x3 full-resolution input-detail branch and one 3x3 fusion layer after P2's fixed bilinear decoder, retaining the fourfold encoder, shallow half-resolution skip, dilated context, frozen data, ignored-boundary objective, optimizer, seed, 2880 steps, production DB thresholds, and unopened public archive
revisions.p3_failure: P3 passed probability and CPU parity but regressed to 82/136 exact, with one exclusion false region, 50 text misses, 39 false regions, and eight multi-region text fixtures. The full-resolution input branch amplified local strokes and compact structures instead of repairing DB continuity.
revisions.execution_blocker: The graph-text-stride4-v4 three-candidate budget is exhausted after P3 failed selection. No V4 candidate may rerun and the sealed public archive must remain unopened.
